source: World of Darkness Campaign Assistant: Generator Prototype Specifications
governance: CHRONICLE SPATIAL ENGINE: MASTER SPECIFICATION & ARCHITECTURE GOVERNANCE

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The rain doesn't wash the street clean here; it just turns the soot into a slick, black oil that ruins your boots and smells of industrial grease.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Dispatch to all units, avoid the alleyway off 4th. Sanitation cleanup crew 'Sector E' is managing a biological spill. Code 4 active."
prototypes.urbanLegend: They say if you dial 0 on the payphone outside the old terminal three times after midnight, a dead voice tells you who is dying next.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: Fluorescent streetlights buzz with a high-pitched frequency that agitates dogs, casting a sick, greenish tint over the cracked pavement.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "All units, reports of malicious mischief at the sub-station. Power grid fluctuating. Maintain visibility lines. Stay in vehicles."
prototypes.urbanLegend: Don't buy the red pills from the guy near the docks. People take them, walk into the salt marshes, and don't come back out.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The air tastes of ozone and heavy copper, like a car battery leaking directly onto your tongue, right before the shadows seem to stretch out.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "EMS requested at 12th Street. Severe lacerations reported. Subject claims they were attacked by a stray dog... a very large dog."
prototypes.urbanLegend: The Mayor hasn't actually been seen in public for three months. That guy giving the press conferences is a double wearing a prosthetic mask.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: An unnatural cold clings to the brick facade, freezing moisture into jagged ice patterns that look uncomfortably like grasping fingers.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Coroner dispatched to the rail yards. Found another vagrant completely exsanguinated. No signs of struggle. Mark it a John Doe."
prototypes.urbanLegend: The graffiti artist 'Ghost' isn't a person. The murals appear when people die violently, mapping out the murder scenes in neon paint.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The smell of burnt insulation and hair blows out of the subway grates, hot and suffocating against the freezing city wind.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Attention transit units, black tracking van reported running red lights near the electronic district. No license plates. Do not engage."
prototypes.urbanLegend: There's a black car that drives without headlights through the industrial park. If it pulls over next to you, don't look at the driver.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The rhythmic thudding of an underground club bass echoes through the plumbing pipes of the entire block, vibrating the soles of your shoes.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Code 3 at 'The Asylum' nightclub. Riot squad standing by. Management refuses entry to municipal inspectors. Security is armed."
prototypes.urbanLegend: The sewer system under the financial district doesn't lead to the river. It drops into an old pre-war bunker complex that isn't on maps.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: Thick, chemical smog settles into low valleys along the asphalt, turning oncoming car headlights into distant, glowing monstrous eyes.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Dispatch, we have a water main breach on 5th Ave. The water looks... unusual. It's thick, foaming, and dissolving the tire rubber."
prototypes.urbanLegend: If you stay at the Riviera Hotel, don't open the door if you hear a child crying in the hallway at 4:14 AM. There are no kids on that floor.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The sound of thousands of pigeons nesting in the rusted iron bridge girders stops instantly, leaving a heavy, unnatural silence.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "All units, tactical frequency swap active. Encryption key Alpha-Six. Reports of unrecognized armed squads moving near the harbor."
prototypes.urbanLegend: A group of local tech students built an AI chatbot that started writing poetry about the 'vampires in the attic' before deleting itself.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: A broken neon sign above a closed theater snaps violently, casting rhythmic crimson flashes across the garbage-strewn gutters.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Fire dispatch, multiple reports of blue flame discharging from the cemetery crematorium. No toxic alarms triggered. Investigating."
prototypes.urbanLegend: The local blood banks are reporting a systemic computer hack that mislabeled thousands of type-O negative storage bags as destroyed.

prototypes.sensoryAnchor: The wind howling through the broken windows of the skyscraper sounds remarkably like a chorus of low, mocking voices.
prototypes.mediaFeed: "Be on the lookout for a male Caucasian, wearing a torn business suit, barefoot, running at speeds exceeding forty miles per hour."
prototypes.urbanLegend: The old historical clock tower downtown doesn't keep time anymore. It counts down the days until the Veil drops entirely.

pressureVariants.title: Quiet Observation
pressureVariants.effect: A hidden watcher records the group without acting.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Identify the observer before the next scene.

pressureVariants.title: Municipal Intervention
pressureVariants.effect: Permits, inspections, closures, or code enforcement threaten the arrangement.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: A mundane deadline advances whenever attention rises.

pressureVariants.title: Faction Challenge
pressureVariants.effect: A rival faction makes a deniable territorial claim.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The first overt power use changes local influence.

pressureVariants.title: Human Witness
pressureVariants.effect: A civilian has noticed the pattern and is collecting evidence.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The witness can become an asset, liability, or dependent.

pressureVariants.title: Corporate Acquisition
pressureVariants.effect: A shell company is buying, demolishing, or securitizing the site.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Trace ownership to reveal the supernatural beneficiary.

pressureVariants.title: Spiritual Disturbance
pressureVariants.effect: The Gauntlet, Dreaming, Shadow, resonance, or occult geometry destabilizes.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Add one environmental manifestation per unresolved scene.

pressureVariants.title: Internal Betrayal
pressureVariants.effect: Someone inside the controlling group trades access for protection.
